people.name: Faith Danielle Hedgepeth
people.role: 19-year-old UNC-Chapel Hill student from Warren County, NC; Haliwa-Saponi; biology major; Gates Millennium Scholar

history.detail: Found dead in her off-campus apartment bedroom; cause of death blunt force trauma to the head, manner homicide (C01, C13).

matters.notes: Class year (sophomore/junior) and hometown (Hollister/Warrenton) disputed (C02, C03). Her private life, injuries and the sexual-assault evidence are on the do-not-use list for narration.

people.name: Miguel Enrique Salguero-Olivares
aliases: Miguel Enrique Oliveras (misspelling in some reports)
people.role: Durham man, 28 at arrest, 33 at trial; the only person ever charged

history.detail: DNA reportedly obtained covertly during a DWI traffic stop (C25).
Arrested without incident; charged with first-degree murder; held without bond (C23, C28).
DA filed notice: death penalty not sought (C29).
First-degree rape, first-degree burglary, first-degree sexual offense added (C30).
Trial set for 28 Sept 2026 (C31).
Pleaded not guilty to all charges (C32). A Nov 2024 plea date is also reported.
Motion to dismiss over lost blood sample denied (C34); IGG evidence excluded (C36).
Third-party-guilt evidence limited (C35).
Jury selection began (C40).
Opening statements; State's case began (C42-C44).
Trial ongoing, State's case continuing; no verdict (C41).

matters.notes: PRESUMED INNOCENT. Not convicted of anything in this matter. Faces life without parole only if convicted of first-degree murder (C33). Custody: Durham County jail/Detention Center (C28). A separate jail drug-possession warrant (C64) is unproven and do-not-use.

people.name: Karena Rosario
people.role: Faith's roommate; found the body; made the 911 call; State witness at trial

history.detail: Found Faith with a friend and called 911 (C11, C12).
Judge barred the defence from presenting her as a third-party suspect (C35).
State witness; cross-examined by the defence (C47, C48).

matters.notes: Never charged; never named a suspect by police in any source found. The defence sought to point at her and the court limited it. The film must NOT present her as a suspect or juxtapose her with the evidence in a way that implies guilt. Her personal medical history given in testimony is do-not-use. Name only as a witness.
